in_marathi.name: Nagalakshmi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wealth and Serpents
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nagalakshmi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nagalakshmi is the goddess of wealth and prosperity, symbolized by snakes. She is also known as the goddess of good luck, fertility, and protection. In Hindu mythology, she is often depicted with a serpent coiled around her waist and holding a lotus flower and a pot of gold.
